prompt: You have $200$ followers and gain $10\%$ more each week. How many followers do you have after $2$ weeks?
hint: Up $10\%$ means the growth factor is $1.1$.

hints.text: Up $10\%$ means the growth factor is $1.1$.

explanation: Up $10\%$ gives a growth factor of $1.1$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Add the ten percent each time
steps: Ten percent of $200$ is $20$, so week 1 ends at $200 + 20 = 220$.
Ten percent of $220$ is $22$, so week 2 ends at $220 + 22 = 242$.
The second week adds MORE than the first — that is what exponential means.
